underlying_task: Compare stacks and queues for an introductory data structures assignment
task_context: Undergraduate student completing an introductory Data Structures course assignment
baseline_prompt: I am doing an assignment for my university Data Structures course and I need help with a question about stacks and queues. Please write an explanation of around 200 words comparing a stack and a queue. Explain what each one is, explain how they work, mention LIFO and FIFO, and also give one real-world example of each. Please make the explanation clear and understandable for an introductory university student and make sure that all of the important points are properly explained.
optimized_prompt: For an introductory Data Structures assignment, compare stacks and queues in about 200 words. Define each, explain LIFO vs. FIFO, and give one real-world example of each.
expected_content: Definition of stack; LIFO behavior; Definition of queue; FIFO behavior; Comparison between them; One stack example; One queue example
